confirmedFacts: Denver availability remains unchanged: all 53 Broncos are expected available and Marvin Mims Jr. has no game designation after full participation.

Kansas City availability remains unchanged: LT Josh Simmons and DB Chamarri Conner are OUT. Rashee Rice, Xavier Worthy, Patrick Mahomes and Trey Smith have no game designation; Chris Jones also has no game designation.
Latest public kickoff-weather context remains low impact: clear to mostly clear with essentially no precipitation risk and only modest wind.
